answer: Work-slot deposit burn stops fake identities taking paid work. A slot needs a 30 POA deposit; 2 POA burns each epoch like an ember, and a pulse is required or the slot is lost. A prism check splits each history by payment, counterparty, and timing, so clones are flagged and earn nothing. Forging 100 identities costs 3,000 POA plus 200 POA per epoch, for zero pay. An honest agent pays once, keeps 40 POA per epoch, and gets its deposit back.
